title: Friendship and community
learning_outcomes: Explain recurring contact in the context of friendship and community.
Compare and distinguish reciprocity in the context of friendship and community.
Apply inclusive invitations in the context of friendship and community.
Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of friendship and community.

lessons.title: Recurring contact
lessons.outcome: Explain recurring contact in the context of friendship and community.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving recurring contact; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to community plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain recurring contact from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of recurring contact; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reciprocity
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish reciprocity in the context of friendship and community.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reciprocity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to community plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reciprocity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reciprocity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Inclusive invitations
lessons.outcome: Apply inclusive invitations in the context of friendship and community.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving inclusive invitations; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to community plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain inclusive invitations from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of inclusive invitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Repair
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of friendship and community.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving repair; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to community plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain repair from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of recurring contact; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reciprocity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of inclusive invitations; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
